0e4b947fb309b38486f050338cc74d7f.overview: After a suicidal teenage girl gives birth, she misguidedly entrusts her baby’s safety to the troubled, deadbeat father, whose violent actions take the viewer on a tour of the foreboding, crumbling shantytown in which they live.

0e6e53be4f11437df8afc3e9399270b3.overview: In 1979, a group of young filmmakers set out to make an adult film in rural Texas, but when their reclusive, elderly hosts catch them in the act, the cast find themselves fighting for their lives.
0e6e53be4f11437df8afc3e9399270b3.tagline: Dying to show you a good time.

0e741cf7b1008d682b973ff7ebc606f3.overview: A farmer's widow takes on the land and her late husband's tempestuous son.
0e741cf7b1008d682b973ff7ebc606f3.tagline: Edna Ferber's epic of American Womanhood

0e7da14dfa04b08f4ed2f298e325d63b.overview: The world is delighted when a spacecraft containing a crew comprised of the world's astronauts lands on the moon, but are shocked when the astronauts discover an old British flag and a document declaring that the moon is taken for Queen Victoria, proving that the astronauts were not the first men on the moon.
0e7da14dfa04b08f4ed2f298e325d63b.tagline: H.G. Wells' Astounding Adventure in Dynamation!

0ef49d2e6ab20afa5f9bf5ab28f816ee.overview: A researcher investigating a notorious serial killer who was hanged 20 years earlier seemingly becomes possessed by the long dead strangler.
0ef49d2e6ab20afa5f9bf5ab28f816ee.tagline: KING OF THE MONSTERS! KARLOFF IN HIS NEW HORROR HIT!
